comparison.objective: Move a ball retainer forward and roll a server-rail member into its channel; candidate registers sensor endpoints.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-member level alignment, insertion between rollers, and controlled rolling versus screwdriver work and fine mounted-part sliding.
comparison.success_condition: Correct retainer order, no shove/miss, member seated and still 1 s; candidate requires two sensed positions retained after tightening.
comparison.reason: The record tests constrained rail insertion, not calibration or fastening. Candidate lacks exact bracket/slot/screw dimensions and force validation.
